subject: RAG qualification: recommended models & retrieval experiments for Galatea
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@galatea-pharma.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — RAG qualification & recommended next experiments

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can get an initial pilot moving quickly.

Call recap (30 min):
- Primary goal: reduce hallucination on clinical guidance queries while preserving recall on internal SOP documents and published literature.
- Constraints: PHI must not leave Galatea VPC during pilot; retention window limited to 7 days; budget guardrail ~USD 6K/month for this proof-of-value.
- Current infra: existing search index (Elasticsearch + custom BM25) + a moderate corpus (~1.1M docs, mostly PDFs).

Redwood recommended experiments (short A/B matrix):
1) Retrieval layer: BM25 baseline vs dense semantic (Faiss/HNSW) over embeddings (sentence-transformer). Measure RetrievalRecall@5/20 and latency at p95.
2) Reranker: no-rerank vs lightweight bi-encoder rerank vs cross-encoder monoT5-style reranker. Primary metric: Precision@1 and factuality score (see metrics below).
3) Model family: two model lanes — high-accuracy lane (Flan-Chat-XL / 20B-ish equivalent) and cost-optimized lane (quantized 7B chat model). We'll run the same prompt set across both lanes to estimate quality delta and token cost.

Suggested evaluation artifacts we can push immediately:
- Prompt set (attached): 120 representative prompts (clinical Qs, policy lookup, partial-PHI masked examples).
- RAG eval plan (attached): experiment matrix, metrics definitions, expected compute footprint.
- Benchmark folder (Drive link): pre-populated with sample outputs and golden answers for 40 prompts.

Grounding & quality metrics (proposed):
- RetrievalRecall@K (K=1,5,20) against hand-labeled relevant docs.
- Factuality@K: fraction of answers that cite a correct source when citation is expected.
- Hallucination rate: binary label if model asserts unsupported facts.
- Answer latency (end-to-end p50/p95).
- Cost per completed prompt (tokens + reranker CPU/GPU).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Please confirm we can run an isolated eval using a copy of the Galatea corpus inside Redwood Private (VPC onboarding) — we flagged data residency in the call.
- Sign off on the attached RAG_eval_plan_Galatea_v1.pdf and prompt set; once signed we'll schedule the 2-week baseline run.
- If approved, we’ll run BM25 vs dense retrieval + monoT5 reranker, and the two model lanes above (estimated 10k eval prompts spread over 2 weeks).

If you want, we can also include a small human-in-the-loop annotation pass (4–6 clinicians) to label the golden set for Factuality@K. That will tighten the evaluation but adds ~1 week.

Thanks — sending attachments in a follow-up (RAG_eval_plan + prompt bundle).

— Jordan

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — RAG qualification & recommended next experiments

Jordan,

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple quick items from our side:
- Data residency: we can provide a sanitized copy in our VPC for the pilot, but we need a brief security questionnaire filled before any data transfer. Can your security team complete our standard ATO pack?
- Budget: the ~$6K/month is fine for a short pilot but we’ll need a tighter estimate for the cross-encoder reranker path — that one looks expensive. Can you provide rough cost delta for monoT5 vs cross-encoder?
- Timing: we’d prefer the human annotation phase if it only adds one week — clinical labels will be important for Factuality metrics.

Also, we need to make sure any prompts containing PHI are removed from the public Drive share. Please confirm the Drive link you provided will be restricted to Galatea + Redwood participants.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Clinical Informatics, Galatea Pharmaceuticals
alex.mercer@galatea-pharma.com | +1 (617) 555-1002
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@galatea-pharma.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — RAG qualification & recommended next experiments

Alex — quick answers and next steps from the Redwood side: 

1) Security pack / ATO: we’ll have our Security Engagement lead (Dev Patel) run through Galatea’s ATO checklist. Dev — I’m looping you to start the questionnaire; Alex, you’ll see an email from dev.patel@redwood.com with the secure intake link.

2) Cost delta (monoT5 vs cross-encoder): rough high-level estimates for the 2-week eval (10k prompts):
   - MonoT5-style lightweight reranker: ~USD 900–1,200 extra compute (CPU + small GPU for embeddings).
   - Cross-encoder reranker: ~USD 4,500–6,500 (GPU time dominates; depends on batch sizing).
   Note: these are estimate ranges — we’ll provide a detailed cost table once we know avg prompt length and QPS.

3) Drive access: Jordan will create a restricted folder share limited to Galatea + Redwood SSO accounts; no public access. All PHI will remain in Galatea VPC snapshot for the pilot — the Drive folder will only contain masked prompts and the evaluation plan.

4) Annotation: we recommend the 4–6 clinician labelers. We can handle the annotation workflow through our labeling partner; expected turnaround ~6–8 business days after cueing.

Next actions (short):
- Dev (security) to send ATO intake link — target: <48 hours.
- Jordan to upload masked prompt set + create restricted Drive folder.
- Alex to confirm annotation budget and availability for two clinicians.

I’ve attached the evaluation plan (same PDFs Jordan referenced) and a quick one-pager on reranker tradeoffs.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — RAG qualification & recommended next experiments

Alex — thanks for the quick replies and the confirmation on annotation. A couple final logistics and timeline proposals: 

Planned timeline (assuming ATO in 48h):
- Day 0–3: Security intake + VPC onboarding + Drive restricted share.
- Day 4–7: Data copy and index prep (BM25 + embedding generation).
- Week 2: Run 10k prompt baseline across BM25 + dense retrieval; run monoT5 reranker candidate.
- Week 3: Cross-encoder run for 2–3k hot prompts (to compare precision delta) + human annotation pass.
- Week 4: Consolidate metrics, Factuality@K report, and recommended production configuration.

Deliverables we’ll produce after the pilot: consolidated workbook (RetrievalRecall@K, Factuality@K, Hallucination rate, per-model cost), sample prompt-to-source mappings, and a config recommendation (batch sizes, kv-cache policy, reranker choice).

Please reply with a one-line approval to proceed under the proposed timeline and we’ll kick off security intake. If you want a narrower scope (no cross-encoder), say so and we’ll update the plan — it’ll save time and reduce cost.

DocuSign link for the pilot SOW (for signatures): https://app.docusign.com/samples/GAL-2026-0012-SOW (we’ll only send formally after you OK the timeline).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Jordan
